statement:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    HasDerivAt (fun e => 2 * ↑π ^ (↑n / 2 - e) / Gamma (↑n / 2 - e))
      (2 * ↑π ^ (↑n / 2) / Gamma (↑n / 2) * ((↑n / 2).digamma - log ↑π)) 0
